alternatives.reason_rejected: Some users may benefit from graph building in non-benchmark scenarios; keeping code but disabling by default is safer
r=-0.01 correlation means zero measurable benefit while adding latency to every tool call

context: Benchmark showed graph building has r=-0.01 correlation with coordination outcomes. Agents spend time building a knowledge graph that subsequent agents never query (neighbors and graph_query are never called).
rationale: Setting auto_populate to false by default removes overhead with zero measured downside. Graph tools remain available for manual use. Users who want auto-population can enable it in config.yml.
summary: Graph auto-population disabled by default (opt-in via graph.auto_populate config)
